about: SKIR2 (2026-11-11): draft owner decisions, in docs/decisions.json's item shape, for the coordinator to fold in (SKIR2 may not write decisions.json)

items.title: Keep SKIR2's list adds
items.body: No card stats changed. Rewards made obtainable: Sphagnum Vole (Map 5), Parrotfish, Coral Reef Shark (10), Gilded Roadwarden (15), Snow Ermine, Harbor Seal, Snow Bunting Archer (17). Guardians (JJ28): Grey Seal Bull (10), Shepherd (17), Marula Elephant (18), Stalactite Pill Bug (19). Fights: Planarian Splitter (7), Swift Fox, Tasmanian Devil, Bramblewood Lynx (13).
options: b) Drop the ones you name.

items.title: Caves & Alcoves needs a second weak card
items.body: 8-2 reads 66% (target 85) and 8-7 46% (target 60). Map 8's only weak card, Stalactite Pill Bug, is already in 5 of 8 fights, the most the rule allows. With it, 8-2 reads about 80%.
options: a) Allow the Pill Bug in 6 of Map 8's fights.
b) You add a weak Map 8 card.

items.title: Fights no legal deck can fix
items.body: 2-1 (63%, target 90) and 2-2 (62%, target 80): every legal Pebble Beach deck reads about 60%. 17-8 (23%, target 40): its Walrus Icebreaker leader and the frost decide it; every deck reads 0-23%. Side 10-A-4 reads 0%.
options: a) Allow a Health or Shield change on these.

items.title: First-clear cards missing from their fight
items.body: 27 of 50 fights that pay a first-clear pack card no longer field that card (SKIR1's rebuild could not see the table). Players win a card they never met in that fight.
options: a) Put each back in its fight in the next road pass.
